measured.askedAbout: San Felipe and Columbia families about 1 am October 2 (minute 5440 on a class clock from dawn September 28).
measured.ride: A Columbia volunteer rode for Victoria at minute 5440 and arrived at 6400, about sixteen hours.
measured.neighbours: Class of 30, seed calls-neighbours: every Matagorda (4) and Columbia (6) family stayed; San Felipe 6 of 8, Mina 3 of 3, Liberty 2 of 4, Victoria 1 of 1 sent a man, and all arrived.

observed: A Columbia family (hh-1, seed call-look) saw "Volunteers from Columbia and the lower Brazos are to gather at James Kerr's on the Lavaca and go on from there. Does somebody from your family go?" in the chosen person's panel, with "Go: ride for Victoria" (since relabelled "Go: ride west to join them, toward Victoria") and "Stay and keep the coast", each with its price. No page errors.
